_meta.notes: Fixed mapping. Randomized-per-run deferred to v2. All prompt paths use kebab-case.

sun-tzu.rationale: Strategic clarity and clean structure fit A-tier Sonnet default.

socrates.rationale: Iterative questioning benefits from mid-tier Sonnet with room for multiple cycles.

marcus-aurelius.rationale: Self-examination benefits from depth; Opus is the appropriate weight for the mirror-holding role.

nietzsche.rationale: Value-critique lens tests local-model register. phi4:14b (US/Microsoft, ~9GB Q4_K_M) retargeted from qwen2.5:14b per 2026-04-21 US-only fleet lock. Reasoning quality comparable; Phi's training corpus diverges sufficiently from Meta Llama for adversarial coverage. Absorbs the retired Heckler function via register.

jung.rationale: Pattern-matching on archetype can run on a terse local model. Depth emerges across the council's full output, not from any single voice.

dialectic.description: Second-pass critique loop where each persona sees N-1 other drafts and may refine. Off by default to keep fast runs fast.
